# Upgrayedd 0.2.1 (3)
This bridge release adds secure signed application updates, an explicit manual update command, and an opt-out daily check disclosed on first launch. It sends no Upgrayedd telemetry or hardware profile, and it always asks before downloading, installing, or restarting.
The background collector now runs from the signed application bundle so its embedded Sparkle framework remains available after installation and future updates.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Install Upgrayedd.app in the approved Applications folder.
